rav.text: Niv-Mizzet defeats every rival to become the last great dragon of Ravnica, then signs the Guildpact and founds the Izzet League.
Bored with the squabbling elementalists, he combines opposing elements to create the first weirds, which he orders to burn, drown, smash and electrocute the quarreling mages.
He also invents mizzium while etching the Guildpact onto a water droplet, and he names it after himself.
Later, Niv-Mizzet kills two nephilim but flies away after an unforeseen attack from another, claiming to have lost interest.

gpt.text: In Guildpact, Niv-Mizzet is the dragon guildmaster of the Izzet League, whose vanity is reflected in his aerie.
Teysa discovers that the death of her Uncle and the deal with Niv-Mizzet were Obzedat schemes, and Kos and the others find Hauc trying to hatch three dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact.

dgm.text: In Dragon's Maze, Niv-Mizzet instructs Ral Zarek to discover the Implicit Maze using Jace's notes.
He then announces that each guild will send one champion to run the maze.

grn.text: In Guilds of Ravnica, Niv-Mizzet withdraws in secrecy to pursue his research, appointing Ral Zarek acting guildleader, and starts the Interlocus experiment to absorb the Guildpact's power.
At the guild summit he asks to change the Guildpact spell to gain the power to fight Bolas, but the guilds distrust his motives.
Dovin Baan sabotages the device, leaving Niv-Mizzet without the extra power, and as Bolas arrives Niv-Mizzet flies off to delay him while Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon.
Niv-Mizzet admits that he did not recognize his own guild the day before.

war.text: In War of the Spark, Niv-Mizzet fights Nicol Bolas in an epic combat that destroys much of Ravnica, and Bolas slays him, leaving only his skull and charred bones.

Having allied with Ugin, Niv-Mizzet had made a device to preserve his spirit, and Nissa Revane leads the guild representatives through a ritual at the ruined Chamber of the Guildpact to resurrect him.
The God-Eternal Kefnet attacks the ritual and Teyo Verada shields the participants, and Niv-Mizzet is reborn with golden scales and a decagon on his chest, then incinerates Kefnet.

He then impales Bolas through the back with Hazoret's spear, and Bontu extracts all of Bolas's sparks, after which Niv-Mizzet becomes Living Guildpact in earnest and gives up the Izzet guildmastership to Ral.

clu.text: Niv-Mizzet appears in Ravnica: Clue Edition as a dragon and the leader of the Izzet.

mbc.text: In Mystery Booster Commander Edition, the Muckslinger Gang bids to become an eleventh guild, and Niv-Mizzet enthusiastically rejects the bid.
